prompt_name: Túi xách – người mẫu cầm túi
prompt:
Create a luxury handbag advertisement video for "túi sách channel".
The person in the FIRST image is the model; keep the exact same face, hairstyle, body and clothes.
The handbag in the SECOND image is the product; it must look EXACTLY the same: shape, size, color,
material, logo, stitching and metal hardware.
ACTION: the model walks confidently on a city street holding the handbag, stops, lifts the bag
slightly and smiles.
CAMERA: medium shot following the model, ends with a slow push-in close-up on the handbag.
QUALITY:
Photorealistic commercial video, natural lighting, realistic physics, sharp product details.
Avoid: distorted product, wrong logo or text, changed colors, extra limbs, deformed hands,
duplicated objects, flickering, sudden scene changes, watermarks, on-screen text.

STRICT CONSISTENCY RULES (must be followed in every frame):
- One continuous shot from start to end: no cuts, no scene changes, no transitions, no fades.
- Slow, smooth, steady motion only; nothing moves fast or jerks.
- Every object visible in the first frame stays visible and unchanged until the last frame:
  nothing appears, disappears, duplicates, merges, melts or changes shape.
- Same background, lighting and colors for the whole video; no flicker, no sudden exposure changes.
- Do not add text, captions, subtitles, logos or watermarks.
- The product from the reference image is the hero: it stays fully inside the frame, in sharp
  focus and clearly visible in EVERY frame.
- Never hide, crop, cover or block the product (no hands, hair, props or camera angles in front of it).
- The product keeps the exact shape, size, proportions, color, material, texture, logo, printed text
  and small details of the reference image in every frame. Parts such as straps, handles, chains,
  buckles, zippers, caps, labels and soles must never vanish, bend, melt or be redrawn.
- If the product rotates, it turns slowly and evenly (about 10 seconds for a full turn); its sides and
  back stay consistent with the front, with no warping during the turn.
- The camera keeps a distance where the whole product fits in frame; at most one gentle push-in at
  the end, never an extreme close-up that cuts parts off.
- The person keeps the same face, hairstyle, skin tone, body and clothes in every frame:
  no face morphing, no identity change, no outfit change.
- Natural anatomy at all times: exactly two arms, two hands with five fingers each, two legs;
  no extra, missing, merged or deformed limbs.
- The person's whole body (or the part being shown) stays inside the frame; no fast spins.
- When holding or wearing the product, the grip stays consistent: the product does not pass through
  the body, float, or jump between hands.

Create a premium fashion commercial video using the provided female model image as the character reference and the provided white HAPAS handbag image as the exact product reference.
Character consistency: Keep the same woman's facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, skin tone, and overall appearance throughout the entire video. Do not change her face between shots.
Product consistency: The handbag must remain exactly consistent with the reference image: elegant white structured rectangular handbag, white top handles, detachable white shoulder strap, gold metal hardware, hanging HAPAS tag and gold HAPAS logo. Do not alter the bag's shape, proportions, color, handles, logo, accessories, stitching, or hardware.
Change the model's original casual outfit into an elegant outfit that matches the white luxury handbag: a sophisticated feminine look in ivory, cream, beige, champagne or soft neutral tones. Use a fitted elegant sleeveless top or blouse combined with a flowing midi skirt or tailored high-waisted trousers, minimal gold jewelry, and elegant neutral heels. The styling should feel modern, clean, luxurious and suitable for a premium handbag advertisement.
Change the background into a refined fashion-show environment that complements the handbag: a luxurious minimalist cream and beige studio with soft architectural curves, warm diffused lighting, subtle shadows, polished light floor, and an elegant runway atmosphere. Keep the background uncluttered so the white handbag remains the visual focus.
Scene 1 – Introduction: Full-body shot. The woman stands elegantly in the center of the scene while holding the handbag naturally at her side. She looks toward the camera and gives a warm, confident, natural smile. Her posture is graceful and relaxed. Slow cinematic camera push-in.
Scene 2 – Product presentation: The woman gently raises the handbag to approximately chest height and presents it toward the camera. She smiles while slowly and delicately swaying the handbag from side to side two or three times. The movement must be smooth, controlled and elegant, allowing the viewer to clearly see the handbag's front design, handles, gold hardware and HAPAS details. The bag should maintain realistic weight, gravity and structure.
Scene 3 – Close-up product reveal: The woman slowly brings the handbag closer toward the camera until the handbag becomes the main focus of the frame. Use a smooth cinematic push-in and shallow depth of field. Clearly showcase the white leather texture, stitching, gold hardware, HAPAS logo and hanging tag. Her face remains visible softly in the background with a pleasant smile. No distortion of the handbag as it approaches the lens.
Scene 4 – Fashion transition: Smooth elegant transition into a wider runway environment. The woman lowers the handbag naturally, holds it gracefully by the top handle or carries it on one arm, turns slightly, and prepares to walk.
Scene 5 – Catwalk finale: The woman confidently performs a slow luxury-fashion catwalk toward the camera while carrying the handbag. Natural arm movement, elegant posture, subtle hip movement, confident soft smile. Alternate between a full-body frontal shot, three-quarter angle, medium shot highlighting the handbag, and a brief side angle. The handbag moves naturally with her steps without excessive swinging.
Finish with the model stopping elegantly near the camera, slightly turning her body to present the handbag, smiling confidently while the handbag is clearly visible as the hero product.

Camera: smooth dolly movement, slow push-in, medium and full-body framing, product close-up, gentle tracking shot during catwalk, stable professional camera, no sudden zoom or shaky movement.
Movement: elegant, slow, graceful, realistic and commercially polished. Avoid exaggerated gestures.
